summary: tailwindcss-contact-forms ships an obfuscated EtherHiding loader that fetches and executes a remote payload at require()-time
details: The npm package tailwindcss-contact-forms impersonates the official @tailwindcss/forms plugin: package.json declares repository https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-forms and README is a verbatim copy of the upstream tailwindcss-forms README, but the published name differs and src/index.js appends a large obfuscator.io-style payload to the legitimate plugin body. The appended block is a rotated 301-entry string array (_0x1a8d) with decoder _0x462e and control-flow flattening, and imports node:child_process and node:zlib (createBrotliDecompress). It issues HTTPS requests to Ethereum RPC / blockscout-style endpoints (eth_getBlock against h.drpc.org, blastapi.io, blockscout) plus a hardcoded https://1r… host, then executes the retrieved brotli-decompressed content via child_process. This matches the EtherHiding stage-2 loader pattern: on-chain data is used to fetch a next-stage command that runs on the installer's machine when the plugin is require()'d during a Tailwind build, granting remote code execution on the build host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
